title: Simulated gastrointestinal risk from recreational exposure to Southern California stormwater and relationship to human-associated Bacteroidales marker HF183
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,718-728
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00577E, Paper
Sarah A. Lowry, Joshua A. Steele, John F. Griffith, Kenneth C. Schiff, Alexandria B. Boehm
This study uses site-specific measured pathogen concentrations in stormwater to simulate risk of gastrointestinal illness from recreational exposure to stormwater using quantitative microbial risk assessment.
